rationale: This is a cosmetic re-specification of the archived "R&D Cash-Earnings Resilience" signal (identical second leg, R&D denominator swapped from sale to at, RANK→IND_RANK), and its second leg is essentially the negative-accruals (Sloan) anomaly, so it offers little new economic content.

Near-duplicate of the archived "Knowledge-Adjusted Equity Runway" — the same cumulative-R&D-addback-over-liabilities construction with re substituted for ceq and the current-ratio leg dropped — which is a mechanical variant rather than a diagnosis of that signal's flat Fama-MacBeth slope.

The second leg is identical to the archived "R&D Debt-Wall Acceleration" and the first leg merely swaps ACCEL for a 3-year MA and sale for at, so this is a smoothing tweak of an already-tested signal rather than a substantively different mechanism.

COALESCE(xad,0) conflates non-reporting firms with genuine zero advertisers, so the first RANK collapses to a large tied mass and the signal will largely degenerate into the second leg — which itself recycles the already-tested accruals/liquidity composite.

Internally inconsistent construction: Compustat intan includes gdwl, so MAX(intan/at, gdwl/at) reduces to intan/at and the "acquired-goodwill" distinction is not actually captured, while the second leg (leverage + negative retained earnings) is a textbook Altman/Ohlson distress composite already probed by the archived goodwill signal.

Substituting cash-flow volatility for the archived signal's cash-burn level introduces a genuinely different mechanism — unpledgeable knowledge assets financed with debt under uncertain internal funding — with a coherent negative sign, though coverage will thin from the 5-year volatility window and cash-flow volatility alone is a partially documented predictor.
